_comment: Array order = display priority. tier 1 = El Clasico highlight (cover + key fixtures). tier 2 = key fixture. tier 3 = regular league match. kind: main | bug. Reorder entries to re-rank. result: W=Done, PPD=Won't Do, HT=UAT, LIVE=QA, SCHED=To Do/Ready.

tickets.title: Lead Listing Quick Actions
tickets.subtitle: Cutting out the midfield
tickets.description: New lead listing UI with Quick Action Buttons on each lead card — Upload Documents, Status Update without navigating into lead detail.
tickets.matchReport: Compressed the play. Instead of navigating three screens deep, field agents could act directly from the listing. Fewer touches, same destination — tiki-taka made practical.

tickets.title: Yoddha Home Optimization
tickets.subtitle: Kickoff in three seconds
tickets.description: Minimised time from app open to first API hit on Yoddha home.
tickets.matchReport: The team was slow out of the tunnel. Diagnosed the bottleneck, reorganised the sequence — first API on the pitch before the crowd noticed. Yoddha home now opens firing.

tickets.title: Chatbot Client Validation
tickets.subtitle: The scouting report that changed the shape
tickets.description: Chatbot client for Saathi Web and mobile — validate chat session clear on login, Yes/No replies, conversation feedback.
tickets.matchReport: Never made it to matchday — but the validation work built the tactical blueprint. Session reset logic, reply handling, and feedback hooks all proved the shape was right. The scout report that guides the next signing.

tickets.title: Saathi Onboarding Walkthroughs
tickets.subtitle: First-team induction
tickets.description: Guide new Saathi app users through dashboard with interactive tooltips highlighting key features to drive engagement.
tickets.matchReport: New signings get a proper induction now — interactive tooltips, key-feature highlights, engagement up from minute one.

tickets.title: Edit Lead Flow Revamp
tickets.subtitle: Midfield rebuilt from scratch
tickets.description: Code revamp of edit lead flow — removed dynamic form dependency, migrated to updated component structure.
tickets.matchReport: Ripped out the dynamic form and rebuilt around updated components. Edit lead now passes through cleanly — every ball finding its target.

tickets.title: Banker Directory
tickets.subtitle: Two-platform deployment
tickets.description: Introduced Banker Directory module on Yoddha App, Saathi App — search banker contacts by name, bank, or branch.
tickets.matchReport: Shipped the same module on two platforms — Yoddha and Saathi App. Field teams could finally find a banker without a WhatsApp shoutout.

tickets.title: Bonanza Contest
tickets.subtitle: Last-minute winner replacing Udaan
tickets.description: Removed Udaan Offer; defined and implemented Bonanza Contest in Saathi app with tiered rewards on leaderboard ranking.
tickets.matchReport: Stoppage-time substitution. Udaan came off, Bonanza came on — tiered rewards, leaderboard logic, all-user eligibility. Ready to live.

tickets.title: PDD/Transaction Upload Revamp
tickets.subtitle: Defensive masterclass
tickets.description: Code revamp of PDD Transaction upload component; preserved Lead listing and Payout ETA functionality.
tickets.matchReport: Rebuilt the back four. Replaced an old upload component while keeping lead listing and payout ETA flows intact — no goals conceded in production.

tickets.title: Checkout Form Revamp
tickets.subtitle: Switching to total football
tickets.description: Checkout form revamped to new UI elements; removed tech debt from old component structure.
tickets.matchReport: Replaced the old structure with the new design-system XI. Tech debt cleared, UI consistent across the form.

tickets.title: RBAC Hierarchy on Saathi App
tickets.subtitle: Tactical discipline
tickets.description: Implemented RBAC hierarchy on Saathi App (My Earnings, My Leads, Create Lead, Status Update) mirroring Saathi Web logic.
tickets.matchReport: Brought app and web onto the same tactical sheet. Roles and permissions now mirror across platforms — no more rogue runs.

tickets.title: OCR Auto-Verification
tickets.subtitle: Through on goal, awaiting VAR
tickets.description: Option to upload auto verification by OCR; push to eligible forcefully.
tickets.matchReport: Clear shot at goal — OCR auto-verification through to QA, force-push to eligible in place. Awaiting the VAR check.
